## Highlights

- Long conversations save native execution state separately from display history. Completed display history is retained in shared immutable segments, reducing repeated checkpoint reads, copies, and writes.
- WebUI draft editing and input navigation avoid repeated full-history work.
- Harness UI now consumes Harness and Stream Protocol `>=0.12.0,<0.13.0`.

## Upgrade notes

This release introduces a forward-only checkpoint format transition. It reads released inline v1 continuations and the new referenced v2 continuations, and writes only referenced v2 continuations. Native state and display archives are stored separately; historical display content remains retained.

Before starting 0.12.0 against an existing data root, stop older TUI and WebUI processes using that root and take a backup. Upgrade every App sharing the root before allowing new writes. Older releases cannot read the new referenced checkpoints and codec-2 objects. Downgrading the package does not convert saved data back; rollback requires restoring the pre-upgrade backup.

Checkpoint work still scales with native state and the active display tail. A single very long active turn can remain expensive.
